sources.topic: Static variable/label lifetime, formatting, field layout, intervals and cancellation

contract.service: Explicit DynamicDisplays, PendantDisplay and supplied port banks; no native display task
contract.bindings: Exact typed read references to static global scalar/field/index/USING storage, captured once; locals/formals/computed values rejected; read-only counter/POSITION observation allowed
contract.values: Live Boolean/enum labels and Pythonic numeric/string formatting; stars for unknown data and question marks for invalid indexes/data
contract.fields: Bounded one-row fields, fixed-width truncation/padding or width-zero partial text, atomic batches without FILE cursor changes; style intent recognized without native glyph effects
contract.clock: Logical quantum per leaf checkpoint while active, explicit host advance/force, positive minimum intervals and one sample without catch-up; finite saturating clock
contract.cancellation: Family/storage-or-port/window identity; all matching locations; clear positive width, retain zero width, restore surviving last samples; cleanup at exhausted history sequence
contract.persistence: Reject active-binding save; keep closed settings, elapsed time and registration sequence plus pendant grids/history; no automatic subscriptions or execution restoration

boundaries: Portable statuses and checkpoint clock rather than controller scheduling/native background execution
No routine-local/formal bindings, implicit task-end cancellation, font/color/size rendering or native port-type discovery
No form/list/table managers, keyboard input, active-reference serialization, strict/controller equivalence
